title: About: Principles (The principles behind the pr…)

f2.default: Trading on your own means nobody else sets the rules. These three come first.

f5.default: Decide what you trade, what you’re looking for and how much you’re prepared to risk before the market gives you a reason to act.

f8.default: Test every idea against the chart and the plan. Feeling confident is not a reason to enter a trade.

f11.default: Some ideas won’t work out. Planning the downside first means a loss is an outcome you prepared for, not a surprise.
